content:
We have IR spectrum with a peak at 1738 cm-1, typical carbonyl stretch. Need number of C=O groups. Could be more than one but only one strong carbonyl peak. However sometimes overlapping. The list includes only one carbonyl region peak. Likely one carbonyl group.

But we might verify with carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra.
